modal.policyBudget: Servers: {count}. Each has a target of {target} players and a separate {minutes}-minute budget of confirmed seeding.
modal.policyTargetNext: When the current server reaches the target, move to the next server in the queue above.
modal.policyTargetSingle: When the selected server reaches the target, finish the mission successfully.
modal.policySuccess: Once all selected servers reach the target, run this action once: {action}.
modal.policyTimeoutNext: Time limit reached: skip the current server and move to the next. If it is the last server, finish the queue and leave Squad open.
modal.policyTimeoutStop: Time limit reached: stop the entire queue and stay in Squad. Remaining servers will not start.
modal.policyTimeoutClose: Time limit reached: stop the entire queue and close Squad.
modal.policyTimeoutSleep: Time limit reached: stop the entire queue and put the PC to sleep if the safety conditions are met.
modal.policyTimeoutShutdown: Time limit reached: stop the entire queue and shut down the PC if the safety conditions are met.
modal.policyTimeoutRetry: Time limit reached: reconnect to the same server with a new timer. Repeat until the target is reached or you stop manually.
modal.policySkippedNotice: A skipped server is not a success. If any server is skipped, the action for a successful queue will not run.
modal.targetsAlreadyMet: The current targets are already met. Sentry will verify them before launch.
modal.selectedServerUnavailable: A selected server is no longer available. Refresh the list and select it again.
modal.customTargetHint: This target applies separately to each selected server.
modal.customTimeoutHint: Every server has its own timer, starting after the player connection is confirmed.
modal.targetAction: After all servers reach the target
modal.targetActionHint: Runs once after the entire queue succeeds. Reaching the target on an earlier server automatically advances to the next.
modal.timeoutAction: If the current server reaches its time limit
modal.timeoutActionHint: This rule applies to one server. Stopping the queue cancels all remaining servers.
modal.actionTargetStay: Finish auto-seeding and stay in Squad
modal.actionTimeoutAbort: Stop the entire queue and stay in Squad
modal.actionTimeoutNext: Skip this server and move to the next
modal.actionTimeoutCloseGame: Stop the entire queue and close Squad
modal.actionTimeoutSleep: Stop the entire queue and put the PC to sleep
modal.actionTimeoutShutdown: Stop the entire queue and shut down the PC
modal.serverSelectionHint: Check the servers you want to seed. They will be launched in numbered sequence.
modal.noServersSelected: Please select at least one server to seed
modal.settingsSaving: Wait for settings to finish saving.

modal.settingsUnavailable: Saved settings must load successfully before starting or changing the mission.
modal.localEndTime: Estimated finish time for the current server

modal.postActionQueueWarning: Sleep or shutdown after success runs only if every selected server reaches the target. Skipping a server after its time limit is not a success.
modal.targetMustExceedCurrent: Target ({target}) must be greater than current players ({current})

potato.title: Potato Mode
potato.subtitle: Extreme CPU & GPU resource reduction during background seeding
potato.quickToggleDesc: Applies low graphics and the selected limit on the next Squad launch
potato.enabledDesc: Citadel Sentry temporarily lowers Squad graphics settings to minimum and limits background framerate
potato.fpsLimitDesc: Target FPS after a cold Squad start; connection stability at 1 FPS depends on the game
potato.lowResolutionDesc: Sets render scale to 25% and windowed resolution to 640×480 while seeding
potato.lowCpuPriorityDesc: Uses Idle priority for each Squad process during seeding and restores its recorded original afterwards.
potato.lowCpuPriorityUnavailable: Lower CPU priority is unavailable on this platform. Turn this option off to use the FPS limit.
potato.autoRestoreDesc: Restore original settings after seeding once Squad closes. Failed missions roll back regardless of this option.
potato.configNotFound: Squad config not found (launch Squad at least once)
potato.restoredSuccess: Original Squad graphics settings restored successfully!
potato.saveBackupButton: Save current settings as baseline backup
potato.saveBackupSuccess: Current Squad settings successfully saved as baseline backup!
potato.cannotSaveWhilePotato: Cannot save backup while Potato Mode is active. Restore normal graphics first.
potato.backupExplainTip: Original settings are saved before seeding and restored after Squad closes. Sentry retains unrelated INI changes made during play and reports conflicts it cannot safely merge.
potato.safeNotice: Keybindings, controls, and mouse sensitivity (Input.ini) are strictly preserved and never modified.
potato.squadRunningNotice: To apply the FPS limit, close Squad normally and then start seeding. Sentry will not close it automatically.
potato.processUnknownNotice: Squad process status could not be verified. Settings changes are blocked until the check succeeds.
potato.restoreInitialBaselineTooltipDesc: Restore original Squad graphics settings captured on the very first launch of Citadel Sentry.
potato.saveBackupTooltipDesc: Save player's current GameUserSettings.ini as the basis for restoration after seeding.
potato.restoreTooltipDesc: Restore original graphics parameters and framerate limit from backup.
potato.restoreInitialBaselineDesc: Restore original Squad graphics settings captured on the very first launch of Citadel Sentry
potato.restorePointsSubtitle: User-saved named snapshots of Squad configuration
